(Currently Amended) Claim 1: A battery assembly comprising: an enclosure; a first battery cell positioned within the enclosure; and a first sensor positioned within the enclosure for detecting at least one force influencing the first battery cell, wherein the first sensor is a contact sensor configured to provide an output signal in response to said detected force.

(Currently Amended) Claim 11: The battery assembly of claim 1 further comprising a second battery cell stacked on top of the first battery cell, wherein the first sensor is positioned between the first battery cell and the second battery cell, and the second battery cell is configured to respond to the output signal of the first sensor.

(Currently Amended) Claim 17: The battery assembly of claim 11 further comprising: a third battery cell stacked on top of the second battery cell; and a second sensor positioned between the third battery cell and the second battery cell for detecting at least one force influencing the third battery cell, wherein the second sensor is a contact sensor configured to provide an output signal in response to said detected force.

(Currently Amended) Claim 25: The battery assembly of claim 1, wherein the first sensor comprises a contact sensor made from a quantum tunneling composite material.
